description.zh: 在保留脚印移动、预测、补全和找错活动的基础上，加入从简单旋转与镜像到交替或组合变换的图形序列，以及需要同时比较行列关系的格子题。G1/G2 用选择式规则说明，不使用自由文本评分；错误后可重试并获得分级提示。
description.en: The existing footprint movement, prediction, fill, and spot activities are extended with shape sequences progressing from simple rotation and reflection to alternating or combined transformations, plus grids requiring row-and-column reasoning. G1/G2 use structured rule choices rather than free-text grading, with retries and staged hints.

designModel.zh: 难度同时沿空间维度、运动规则、路径长度、图形变换和行列推理递进。移动题继续穷举验证唯一位置；变换和格子题生成互异选项，并验证正确图形只出现一次。
designModel.en: Difficulty progresses across space dimension, motion rule, path length, transformation, and row-column reasoning. Movement tasks retain exhaustive unique-position checks; transformation and grid tasks generate distinct options and verify that the correct completion appears exactly once.

ageRange.noteZh: K1 一排荷叶、每次跳一样远约 4 岁；G2 碰边反弹约 7 岁。
ageRange.noteEn: K1 a row of pads with equal hops suits about 4; G2 bouncing suits about 7.

seriesBoundary.policyZh: 本模块属小精灵系列 · 规律猎手，训练的是位置变化的规律（下一步在哪、少了哪个、放错了哪个）。它与 learning/math/pattern 共用 RG.PATTERN.SPATIAL.RELATION：那里教空间关系的概念和描述，本模块只让孩子在格子上发现并使用位置规律。原先的“带墙找路线”已移出：路线选择由策略大师（近路还是远路）承担。
seriesBoundary.policyEn: This module belongs to MindSeeds - Pattern Hunter and trains patterns of position change: where the next step lands, which footprint is missing, which is misplaced. It shares RG.PATTERN.SPATIAL.RELATION with learning/math/pattern, which teaches the concepts and vocabulary of spatial relations, while this module only has the child find and use positional rules on a grid. The earlier walled route-finding has moved out: route choice now lives in Strategy Master (Near or Far).

geneReporting.ruleZh: 每次 Attempt 上报 RG.PATTERN.SPATIAL.RELATION，不随等级变化。
geneReporting.ruleEn: Every attempt reports RG.PATTERN.SPATIAL.RELATION, regardless of grade.

rootGeneScopeNote.zh: 本模块的课程范围与当前上报集合恰好相同（两个基因，每次都报），所以这份清单与 metadata/game.json 里 spatial-pattern-hunter 条目的 rootGeneIds 应当逐项一致，由校验器 S1 与代码对撞。
rootGeneScopeNote.en: This module's curriculum scope and what it actually reports are the same set (two genes, both every time), so this list should match the spatial-pattern-hunter entry's rootGeneIds in metadata/game.json item for item, which S1 collides against the code.

difficultyAxes.noteZh: line 是一排，只有左右；grid 是格子，有行有列。
difficultyAxes.noteEn: line is a single row (left and right only); grid has rows and columns.

difficultyAxes.noteZh: hop 每步一样；stair 两种走法轮流；bounce 斜着走、碰到边反弹。
difficultyAxes.noteEn: hop - every step the same; stair - two moves in turns; bounce - diagonal, reflecting at edges.

difficultyAxes.noteZh: 轨迹上的脚印个数（含需要预测的）。
difficultyAxes.noteEn: How many footprints the trail has, including those to predict.

difficultyAxes.noteZh: 从单步旋转到区分镜像，再到交替与组合变化。
difficultyAxes.noteEn: From one-step rotation through reflection discrimination to alternating and combined changes.

difficultyAxes.noteZh: 从无需矩阵，到按列变化，再到同时满足行列关系。
difficultyAxes.noteEn: From no matrix reasoning, to introductory column patterns, to relations that satisfy rows and columns.

sessionPolicy.noteZh: 一次 6 题，通过线 75%（5/6）。没有静态题库：generator.js 现生成，玩完立即换一批；每题用穷举验证答案唯一。
sessionPolicy.noteEn: Six items per run, passing at 75% (5/6). No static bank: generator.js builds each set and a new one is swapped in when the run ends; every item is verified by brute force to have exactly one answer.

levelMap.objectiveZh: 在荷叶上按相同步移动，并从不对称图形中完成简单单步旋转。
levelMap.objectiveEn: Follow equal hops on lily pads and complete a simple one-step rotation with an asymmetric shape.

levelMap.objectiveZh: 在格子中按相同步移动，并区分简单旋转与镜像。
levelMap.objectiveEn: Follow equal grid moves and distinguish simple rotation from reflection.

levelMap.objectiveZh: 保留楼梯步任务，完成交替变换和入门行列格子，并选择规则说明。
levelMap.objectiveEn: Keep staircase tasks, complete alternating transformations and introductory row-column grids, and choose a rule explanation.

levelMap.objectiveZh: 保留反弹任务，完成组合变换与行列关系格子，并选择能解释全部变化的规则。
levelMap.objectiveEn: Keep bounce tasks, complete combined transformations and row-column grids, and choose the rule explaining all changes.

statistics.noteZh: 报告 process 保留 tiers、retries、hints，并记录本轮 rules、contentFamilies、taskForms 和 explanationUsage。
statistics.noteEn: The report process retains tiers, retries, and hints, and records rules, contentFamilies, taskForms, and explanationUsage.

exampleQueries: 哪些练习训练前瞻规划而不是一眼判断？
空间关系和 learning 里的数学规律有什么区别？
